name: SQLite raw predicate and order
sql: SELECT "stories".* FROM "stories" WHERE (score >= 0) ORDER BY created_at DESC

name: SQLite raw join
sql: SELECT "users".* FROM "users" INNER JOIN posts ON posts.user_id = users.id WHERE posts.published = 1

name: SQLite correlated EXISTS subquery
sql: SELECT "users".* FROM "users" WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE posts.user_id = users.id)

name: SQLite derived table
sql: SELECT recent_posts.* FROM (SELECT posts.* FROM posts WHERE posts.created_at >= '2026-01-01') recent_posts

name: SQLite CTE
sql: WITH recent_posts AS (SELECT posts.* FROM posts WHERE posts.created_at >= '2026-01-01') SELECT recent_posts.* FROM recent_posts

name: SQLite CTE shadows a physical table
sql: WITH posts AS (SELECT physical_posts.* FROM main.posts AS physical_posts WHERE physical_posts.published = 1) SELECT posts.* FROM posts

name: PostgreSQL recursive CTE
sql: WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (SELECT nodes.* FROM nodes WHERE nodes.parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT nodes.* FROM nodes JOIN descendants ON descendants.id = nodes.parent_id) SELECT descendants.* FROM descendants

name: PostgreSQL full-text search
sql: SELECT "stories".* FROM "stories" WHERE stories.search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'rails') ORDER BY ts_rank(stories.search_vector, plainto_tsquery('english', 'rails')) DESC

name: PostgreSQL schema-qualified join
sql: SELECT accounts.* FROM public.accounts JOIN audit.events ON events.account_id = accounts.id WHERE events.kind = 'login'

name: PostgreSQL nested IN subquery
sql: SELECT projects.* FROM projects WHERE projects.id IN (SELECT memberships.project_id FROM memberships WHERE memberships.user_id = 42)

name: MySQL derived table join
sql: SELECT users.* FROM users JOIN (SELECT orders.user_id FROM orders WHERE orders.state = 'paid') paid_orders ON paid_orders.user_id = users.id
